title: Ready machine configuration
statement: Let $a$ be a configuration of the machine $A$ on input $x$, and let $m$ be a natural number. The configuration is ready when its state is the initial state of $A$, its input head is at position $1$, and its output is empty. In addition, on every work tape $i$, every cell at position $z$ with $a$'s head position minus $m$ at most $z$ is blank.
